title: CUMULUS MEDIA INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Cumulus Media Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas entered a confirmation order on April 15, 2026 for the company's Modified Joint Prepackaged Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization. The company, a radio broadcasting firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA, continues operating as debtor-in-possession while awaiting conditions precedent including FCC Approval before the plan becomes effective.
key_points: Cumulus Media Inc. commenced Chapter 11 proceedings on March 4, 2026 in the Southern District of Texas (Case No. 26-90346)
Bankruptcy Court confirmed the Plan on April 15, 2026 via the Confirmation Order
Company expects Effective Date to occur once conditions precedent are satisfied, including FCC Approval and other regulatory approvals
The Plan provides for restructuring of claims including Other Secured Claims, Other Priority Claims, ABL Facility Claims, and 2029 Secured Claims
Exit Convertible Notes and 2029 Secured Claims Equity Distribution will be issued to holders of 2029 Secured Claims on the Effective Date
The company can make no assurances as to when, or if, the Plan will become effective
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate bankruptcy confirmation for a single media company. It has no implications for monetary policy, market structure, or broader market dynamics. The filing is of interest only to Cumulus Media shareholders and creditors evaluating their recovery under the reorganization plan.
